hero.title: How it works
hero.description: From raw PDFs to structured JSON in three simple steps.

steps.title: 1. Upload Your Documents
steps.description: Drag and drop any PDF, Word, or text file into our secure portal. We support bulk uploads and API integrations for automated pipelines.

steps.title: 2. AI Analysis & OCR
steps.description: Our vision models instantly digitize scans and our LLMs parse the content, identifying key entities, tables, and complex unstructured data.

steps.title: 3. Extract Insights
steps.description: Chat with your documents, export to JSON/CSV, or pipe the structured data directly into your CRM or database using our webhooks.
